00094 /**

00096  * when an item is first highlighted within a list box.  For a dropdown box,
00097  * this function is called when the user selects an item, with the item
00098  * displayed in the dropdown box

00100  * index1 and index2 describe a range of items when the list supports
00101  * selection of multiple items.
00102  *
00103  * Normally, applications would listen for a kHxListSelected message rather
00104  * than use this callback.  
00105  */
00106 typedef HxResult (*HxListSelectionCallback)(HxListSelectionType_t type,
00107                                             int32_t index1, int32_t index2,
00108                                             void* pData);

00122 /**
00123  * @brief               Add an item to a list
00124  *
00125  * HxListAddItem adds a new item to a dropdown box or list box.
00126  *
00127  * An item is a null-terminated string with an optional image.
00128  *
00129  * The incoming pIndex argument is the index into the array of items where the
00130  * item should be inserted.  If pIndex is less than 0, or if pIndex is greater  
00131  * than the existing number of items in the list, the new item is appended to
00132  * the list.  The index where the new item was inserted is returned in the 
00133  * outgoing pIndex.
00134  *
00135  * @param pList         IN:     Pointer to a list
00136  * @param pText         IN:     Null-terminated string
00137  * @param pIndex        IN/OUT: Pointer to index where item is to be inserted
00138  *
00139  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.  
00140  *
00141  **/
00142 HxResult HxListAddItem(HxList_t* pList, const char* pText, int32_t* pIndex);

00263 /**
00264  * @brief               Lookup an item's string value 
00265  *
00266  * This function returns the string for an item in a dropdown box or list box.
00267  *
00268  * The string is copied into pBuffer.  If pBuffer is NULL, then *pSize is set
00269  * to the length of the item's string, and HX_OK is returned, so that the
00270  * caller can allocate a buffer of appropriate size for the item's
00271  * null-terminated string.
00272  *
00273  * The incoming value of *pSize is the size of pBuffer.  If pBuffer is too
00274  * small to hold the string, *pSize is set to the length of the string, and
00275  * HX_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL is returned.
00276  *
00277  * @param pList         IN:     Pointer to a list
00278  * @param index         IN:     Index of the item
00279  * @param pBuffer       OUT:    Pointer to buffer to store the string
00280  * @param pSize         IN/OUT: Size of buffer, or size of item's string
00281  *
00282  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.  Returns
00283  *                              HX_INVALID_ARG if index is invalid or if
00284  *                              the item's string is NULL.
00285  *
00286  **/
00287 HxResult HxListGetItem(HxList_t* pList, int32_t index, char* pBuffer,
00288                             int32_t* pSize);

00399  * @param index         IN:     Index of item

00403  *                              HX_INVALID_ARG if index not valid.
